2: import path from 'path';
3: import { extractFrontmatter } from './frontmatter';
4: import { renderMarkdown } from './markdown';

8: export interface BuildResult {

13: export async function listMarkdownFiles(dir: string): Promise<string[]> {
14:   const out: string[] = [];
15:   const entries = await fs.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
16:   for (const entry of entries) {
17:     const full = path.join(dir, entry.name);
18:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
19:       out.push(...(await listMarkdownFiles(full)));
20:     } else if (entry.isFile() && entry.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md')) {
21:       out.push(full);
22:     }
23:   }
24:   return out;
25: }
26: 
27: function toTitle(slug: string): string {
28:   const base = path.basename(slug);
29:   return base
30:     .replace(/[-_]+/g, ' ')
31:     .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
32:     .trim()
33:     .replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
34: }
35: 
36: export async function readPage(filePath: string, contentDir: string): Promise<Page> {
37:   const source = await fs.readFile(filePath, 'utf8');
38:   const { frontmatter, content } = extractFrontmatter(source);
39:   const rel = path.relative(contentDir, filePath).split(path.sep).join('/');
40:   const slug = rel.replace(/\.md$/i, '');
41:   const title = frontmatter.title || toTitle(slug);
42:   return {
43:     slug,
44:     title,
45:     date: frontmatter.date,
46:     tags: frontmatter.tags,
47:     html: renderMarkdown(content),
48:   };
49: }
50: 
51: function comparePages(a: Page, b: Page): number {
52:   const da = a.date ? Date.parse(a.date) : NaN;
53:   const db = b.date ? Date.parse(b.date) : NaN;
54:   const daValid = !Number.isNaN(da);
55:   const dbValid = !Number.isNaN(db);
56: 
57:   if (daValid && dbValid) {
58:     if (da !== db) {
59:       return db - da;
60:     }
61:   } else if (daValid) {
62:     return -1;
63:   } else if (dbValid) {
64:     return 1;
65:   }
66:   return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
67: }
68: 
69: export async function buildSite(
70:   contentDir: string,
71:   outputDir: string
72: ): Promise<BuildResult> {
73:   const files = await listMarkdownFiles(contentDir);
74: 
75:   const pages: Page[] = [];
76:   for (const file of files) {
77:     pages.push(await readPage(file, contentDir));
78:   }
79:   pages.sort(comparePages);
80: 
81:   await fs.mkdir(outputDir, { recursive: true });
82:   await fs.writeFile(path.join(outputDir, 'index.html'), renderIndexHtml(pages), 'utf8');
83: 
84:   for (const page of pages) {
85:     const outPath = path.join(outputDir, `${page.slug}.html`);
86:     await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(outPath), { recursive: true });
87:     await fs.writeFile(outPath, renderPageHtml(page), 'utf8');
88:   }
89: 
90:   return { pages, outputDir };
91: }

1: import matter from 'gray-matter';
2: 
3: export interface Frontmatter {
4:   title: string;
5:   date?: string;
6:   tags: string[];
7: }
8: 
9: export interface ParsedDocument {
10:   frontmatter: Frontmatter;
11:   content: string;
12: }
13: 
14: // gray-matter requires the opening `---` to be the very first bytes of the
15: // file, so we extract the block manually (allowing an optional BOM) and hand
16: // only the raw frontmatter to gray-matter for YAML parsing.
17: const FRONTMATTER_RE = /^\uFEFF?---[ \t]*\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n---[ \t]*(?:\r?\n|$)/;
18: 
19: function dateToString(value: unknown): string | undefined {
20:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
21:     return value;
22:   }
23:   if (value instanceof Date && !Number.isNaN(value.getTime())) {
24:     return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
25:   }
26:   return undefined;
27: }
28: 
29: function normalizeTags(value: unknown): string[] {
30:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
31:     return value
32:       .filter((v): v is string => typeof v === 'string')
33:       .map((v) => v.trim())
34:       .filter((v) => v.length > 0);
35:   }
36:   if (typeof value === 'string') {
37:     return value
38:       .split(',')
39:       .map((v) => v.trim())
40:       .filter((v) => v.length > 0);
41:   }
42:   return [];
43: }
44: 
45: export function extractFrontmatter(source: string): ParsedDocument {
46:   const match = FRONTMATTER_RE.exec(source);
47:   if (!match) {
48:     return { frontmatter: { title: '', tags: [] }, content: source };
49:   }
50: 
51:   const parsed = matter(match[0]);
52:   const raw = parsed.data as Record<string, unknown>;
53: 
54:   return {
55:     frontmatter: {
56:       title: typeof raw.title === 'string' ? raw.title : '',
57:       date: dateToString(raw.date),
58:       tags: normalizeTags(raw.tags),
59:     },
60:     content: source.slice(match[0].length),
61:   };
62: }

Implemented Handlebars template/layout support:

- `src/engine.ts` — `createTemplateEngine()` loads `.hbs` templates, layouts (`templates/layouts/`), and partials (`templates/partials/`) with built-in fallbacks.
- `src/frontmatter.ts` — parses `template` and `layout` frontmatter.
- `src/types.ts` — `Page` now carries optional `template`/`layout`.
- `src/generate.ts` — `buildSite(content, output, templatesDir = './templates')` renders pages via the engine.
- `src/cli.ts` — added `--templates`/`-t` option.
- `tests/templates.test.ts` — template/layout/partial/index tests; added frontmatter and CLI cases.
